GHA.note: Training covers algorithmic bias and risks; no rule or authority stated.

facts.fact: TechAfrica News says the civil service AI training supports implementation of Ghana's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2023-2033).

The Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, with UNESCO, launched an AI literacy programme for civil servants; the first three-day cohort ran 24-26 March 2026, with four cohorts planned through May on a training-of-trainers model for ministries, departments and agencies.
facts.system: national AI literacy programme for civil servants
